prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready", "Use quick hotkeys or right-click your pet anytime to bring up controls and talk options."]
1: ["Setting Up Companion Boundaries", "Choose where on your screen your pet should roam while we build its desktop animations.", "Roaming Area"]
2: ["Save Your Companion to Your Account", "Sign in now to lock your selected pet into your cloud collection."]
3: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Give your desktop pet a unique name and select its starting trait badge.", "Companion Name", "Trait Badge"]
4: ["Returning user? Sign in with your original account method to automatically restore your saved pets."]
5: ["Verifying desktop overlay permissions"]
6: ["Choose Your Pet's Playstyle Path", "Swipe through available paths to pick the experience that matches your daily desktop routine."]
7: ["Feel free to work on other apps. We'll send a system alert as soon as your pet reaches your desktop!"]
8: ["Your Companion is Ready on Desktop!", "Right-click your pet to interact, or hold Shift to drag it anywhere on your screens.", "Spawn Desktop Pet"]
9: ["Adopt Your Companion & Unlock a Free Starter Toy", "Completing adoption today includes an exclusive desktop toy accessory!", "Free Starter Toy Unlocked"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras and creates time-based urgency.
